page_title: GET 3-2 OSA | Getafe v Osasuna 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Alejandro Hernandez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Some great controlled play and passing from Osasuna. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+8' Carles Alena (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sergio Herrera intercepts the ball.
90+6' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
90+3' A yellow card is awarded to Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe).
90+2' Fabrizio Angileri (Getafe) expresses his disappointment as he receives a straight red card.
90+1' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) unleashes a shot from the free kick, but blazes it over. This is a perfect example of a wasted chance. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
90' Djene (Getafe) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
89' The attendance for today's match is 9808.
88' The referee gives a yellow card to Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
88' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Ruben Pena is replaced by Jesus Areso (Osasuna).
88' It will be a substitution. Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) is ready to enter the pitch as Diego Rico walks off.

86' 3 - 2 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go into the top of the net. The score changes to 3:2.
86' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
84' Damian Suarez (Getafe) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
83' A cross into the box from Mason Greenwood (Getafe) is cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
81' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
80' A cross into the box finds the head of Damian Suarez (Getafe) who steers it goalwards, but Sergio Herrera manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch for Aimar Oroz.
79' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raul (Osasuna) replacing Ante Budimir.
77' Substitution. Mason Greenwood (Getafe) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Juanmi Latasa walks off.
75' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
72' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
70' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
68' Here is a change. Kike Barja is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna).
68' The game has come to an end for Chimy Avila. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
68' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
67' Kike Barja (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
64' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) replaces Domingos Duarte.
61' Carles Alena (Getafe) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jose Angel Carmona.
61' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Jaime Mata will be replaced by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe).
60' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
57' 2 - 2 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for David Soria to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
57' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

56' David Soria (Getafe) jumps into a tackle and Alejandro Hernandez signals a foul. PENALTY to Osasuna! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
55' David Soria (Getafe) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
53' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Getafe players have a reason to celebrate!
52' Wait! Referee Alejandro Hernandez has indicated he is going to review the Getafe goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
51' 2 - 1 Goal! Diego Rico gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) climbs highest and powers a close-range header inside the left post. 2:1.
49' Damian Suarez (Getafe) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

48' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Sergio Herrera makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal. The ball is out of play and Getafe manage to earn a corner.
48' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Damian Suarez (Getafe) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' 1 - 1 Goal! Aimar Oroz plays in Iker Munoz (Osasuna), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the left side of the net! Great finish - 1:1.
45' The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
45' Kike Barja (Osasuna) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Osasuna are going to take it.
43' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) produces a header from long distance, but his naive attempt ends way over the bar.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Damian Suarez (Getafe) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
41' Diego Rico (Getafe) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
36' 1 - 0 Damian Suarez takes over corner duties and expertly finds Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe), who jumps highest and coolly plants a bullet header into the left side of the goal. The score is now 1:0.
36' Damian Suarez (Getafe) will take the corner.
36' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Getafe win a corner kick.
35' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
34' Osasuna win a corner.
34' An attempted cross from Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Osasuna will have a corner.
32' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Osasuna.
28' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) has a goal ruled out for offside!
26' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

23' What an opportunity! Chimy Avila (Osasuna) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post! The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
20' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
17' A lofted cross from Jaime Mata (Getafe) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
15' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) and Chimy Avila combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
10' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
9' Jaime Mata (Getafe) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
7' Jaime Mata (Getafe) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
5' Osasuna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
5' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Osasuna earn a corner.
4' A spell of possession for Osasuna in an attempt to control the game.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Osasuna will kick the game off.
Alejandro Hernandez is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
